protocol: Freeze this file and manifest before the first model evaluation.
Perform one declared final model run using fixed code, prompt, model and budget settings.
Report failures and abstentions; do not silently omit them or retry until successful.
Do not change prompts, thresholds, code or labels to improve the score on this final set.
If these examples later inform changes, reclassify future runs as regression checks.
limitations: Original authored synthetic examples; no private player data, model predictions or prior model outputs were used as labels.
The author knew the taxonomy and development context. This is a separately frozen test, not blind independent human annotation.
Only four examples per language and 24 total; results do not estimate real-world accuracy or native-language fluency.
The earlier holdout has already been studied; this final file must remain separate from it and from training.
Exact text, ID and scenario-family overlap checks do not prove absence of all semantic similarity.
There are no reviewed draft or citation targets. Classification labels alone cannot measure reply usefulness or citation relevance.
